name: ProtectedViewWindow
remarks: Documents displayed in a Protected View window cannot be edited and are restricted from running active content such as Visual Basic for Applications macros and Data Connections. Use ProtectedViewWindows (_index_), where _index_ is the index number to return a single ProtectedViewWindow object.
example:
Dim pvWindow As ProtectedViewWindow

Set pvWindow = ProtectedViewWindows(1)

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ProtectedViewWindow object.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets the caption text that is displayed in the title bar of the document or Protected View window. Read/write String.

properties.name: Document
properties.description: Returns a Document object associated with the Protected View window. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long, in points, that represents the horizontal position of the specified Protected View window. Read/write.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical position, in points, of the specified Protected View window. Read/write Long

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width, in points, of the specified Protected View window. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the Protected View window. Read/write Long.

properties.name: WindowState
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the specified Protected View window. Read/write WdWindowState.

properties.name: Active
properties.description: True if the specified Protected View window is active. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the position of an item in a collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: True if the specified Protected View window is visible. Read/write. Boolean.

properties.name: SourceName
properties.description: Returns the name of the source file for the specified Protected View window. Read-only String.

properties.name: SourcePath
properties.description: Returns the path of the source file for the specified Protected View window. Read-only String.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the specified Protected View window.

methods.name: Edit
methods.signature: Edit([PasswordTemplate As Variant], [WritePasswordDocument As Variant], [WritePasswordTemplate As Variant]) As Document

parameters.name: PasswordTemplate
parameters.description: The password for opening the template.

parameters.name: WritePasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password for saving changes to the document.

parameters.name: WritePasswordTemplate
parameters.description: The password for saving changes to the template.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the specified Protected View window.
